help.zoomText: pinch or twist with two fingers.

credits.title: Credits
credits.blurb: This real-time Mandelbrot renderer is developed by Guillaume Collombet. It relies on WebGPU for parallel GPU computing, Vue 3 for the interface, and Rust/WebAssembly for arbitrary-precision reference computations.
